topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: There it was, among the jumble of memories and misfits, a fuzzy chestnut patch on an ear catching the light just so. My teddy, the silent keeper of secrets and fears, the witness to all my young solemn oaths. His fur, a little worn, a whisper of the past, softer than I remembered. Holding him brought back the scent of home, a warm embrace I hadn’t realized I carried with me all these years. The world around the yard sale faded, and for a moment, it was just us, like no time had passed at all. I brought him back to my place, found a spot for him on the shelf, where he could watch over new adventures, just as he did the old.
